arguments.command:
cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/overlay.py
import slicer
import os

# Input and output paths
input_path = '/app/input/case_7f3a9c_mri.nii.gz'
output_path = '/app/artifacts/prostate_red_overlay.nii.gz'

# Load volume
volume_node = slicer.util.loadVolume(input_path)

# Create segmentation node
seg_node = slicer.mrmlScene.AddNewNodeByClass('vtkMRMLSegmentationNode')
seg_node.SetName('ProstateSeg')

# Threshold segmentation: assume prostate intensity between 0-200
threshold = slicer.modules.thresholdsegmentation.logic().ThresholdSegmentVolume(volume_node, 0, 200)
seg_node.GetSegmentation().AddSegmentFromLabelmapVolumeNode(threshold, 'Prostate', 'red')

# Create labelmap from segmentation
labelmap_node = slicer.mrmlScene.AddNewNodeByClass('vtkMRMLLabelMapVolumeNode')
labelmap_node.SetName('ProstateLabelMap')
seg_node.GetSegmentation().CreateLabelmapVolumeNode(labelmap_node, volume_node.GetImageData(), 0)

# Create a new volume where prostate voxels set to 255
# Copy original volume data
import numpy as np
import SimpleITK as sitk

orig = sitk.ReadImage(input_path)
arr = sitk.GetArrayFromImage(orig)
# Create mask
mask = (arr > 0) & (arr <= 200)
arr[mask] = 255
# Write output
out_img = sitk.GetImageFromArray(arr)
out_img.CopyInformation(orig)
sitk.WriteImage(out_img, output_path)

print('Overlay written to', output_path)
EOF

import nibabel as nib
import numpy as np
import os
input_path='/app/input/case_7f3a9c_mri.nii.gz'
output_path='/app/artifacts/overlay.nii.gz'
img=nib.load(input_path)
arr=img.get_fdata()
mask=(arr>0)&(arr<=200)
arr[mask]=255
out=nib.Nifti1Image(arr, img.affine, img.header)
print('saving')
out.to_filename(output_path)
print('done')
PY
